subject: What a round fetches once a structured board is no longer filtered by the markets its catalog entry declares
method: scripts/ats_provider.py fetch_board against every enabled, verified, automation-allowed board seed carrying a board_token, with defer_content. Read-only: nothing written to the jobs table or the registry. Locations placed by market_plan.normalize_location for the ie figures; the country census below matches the location strings the boards themselves publish, and is a census of the data rather than the placement the pipeline does.

ie_round.note: +32 postings, +5.8%. Small, and expected: ie already carries 38 curated sources, so the boards it was missing are the ones that barely serve it. 7 of the 36 newly admitted boards had any ie posting at all -- toast (19), pinterest (5), reddit (2), coinbase (2), airbnb (2), synthesia (1), block (1).

country_census.note: The same 10,264 postings by the country their location names. This is what the change is actually for: a market that does not exist yet costs nothing on the source side, because the postings are already being fetched.

bearing_on_the_first_release.netherlands: 147 postings are in hand and discarded, from boards already fetched. Adding nl needs a geography entry, not a source hunt: the ≥3 local / ≥10 global seed minimum was the reason a new market cost roughly 13 curated entries, and it is the structured half of that which no longer applies.
bearing_on_the_first_release.caveat: The census counts what the boards write, not what the pipeline can place. `normalize_location` still resolves only the cities and country aliases the market catalog lists, so a market has to exist before any of these postings can be attributed to it.

what_was_removed.markets_json_source_ids: 171 entries, a per-market mirror of the `markets` each source declares in source_seeds.json, checked for equality and separately fed to discovery_plan as a third gate on the same fact.
what_was_removed.seed_promotion_link_markets: 21 lines of text surgery that inserted a promoted source id into each market's block of that mirror.
